description: This file contains unit tests for the VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter class, verifying its behavior when handling AMQP connections, message processing, connection counting, capacity limits, and command handling in an Eclipse Hono environment.

classes.name: VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter, verifying various behaviors related to AMQP connection handling, messaging, and resource management in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, mocks dependencies, and sets up configurations before each test.

methods.name: testStartUsesClientProvidedAmqpServer
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter uses a client-provided ProtonServer instance for AMQP server setup.

methods.name: testAdapterSupportsAnonymousRelay
methods.description: Checks that when a device connects, the adapter's open frame offers the ANONYMOUS-RELAY capability.

methods.name: testAdapterAcceptsAnonymousRelayReceiverOnly
methods.description: Ensures that links with a target address are rejected by the adapter.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithAtMostOnceDeliverySemantics
methods.description: Validates that a 'fire-and-forget' telemetry message is forwarded downstream and acknowledged immediately.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithAtLeastOnceDeliverySemantics
methods.description: Validates that a reliably delivered telemetry message involves waiting for downstream acknowledgment before settling.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Tests that telemetry from a device associated with a disabled tenant is rejected and reported accordingly.

methods.name: testUploadEventFailsForGatewayOfDifferentTenant
methods.description: Verifies upload failure of an event sent by a gateway for a device in a different tenant.

methods.name: testAdapterOpensSenderLinkAndNotifyDownstreamApplication
methods.description: Checks that the adapter opens the command sender link and notifies downstream with an empty notification message.

methods.name: testAdapterClosesCommandConsumerWhenDeviceClosesReceiverLink
methods.description: Verifies that the command consumer is closed and an empty event is sent when the device closes its receiver link.

methods.name: testAdapterClosesCommandConsumerWhenConnectionToDeviceIsLost
methods.description: Checks that the command consumer is closed and notification sent when connection to device is lost.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseSucceeds
methods.description: Validates forwarding of command responses downstream, ensuring metrics are reported.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandAccepted
methods.description: Verifies proper signaling when a one-way command is accepted and remotely settled with an Accepted state.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandRejected
methods.description: Verifies proper signaling when a one-way command is rejected.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandReleased
methods.description: Verifies signaling for commands released or unsettled.

methods.name: testConnectionCount
methods.description: Ensures connection count metrics are incremented/decremented on connect/disconnect.

methods.name: testConnectionCountForAnonymousDevice
methods.description: Checks connection metrics behavior for unauthenticated devices.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForATelemetryMessage
methods.description: Verifies rejection and reporting when telemetry message limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForAnEventMessage
methods.description: Verifies rejection and reporting for event message limit exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForACommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Verifies rejection and reporting for command response message limit exceeded.
